final_resume.summary: Computer Science graduate (2025) seeking Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud, with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React. Demonstrated ability to design scalable REST APIs, write production-grade code with comprehensive testing, and collaborate effectively on technical design and code quality.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Designed and built a Spring Boot REST API with Java backend and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses among groups. Integrated Razorpay payment gateway with webhook handling for payment state transitions (created, captured, refunded). Wrote 40 JUnit tests to ensure code quality and containerised the full-stack application with Docker for consistent deployment.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Developed a Java and Spring Boot microservice with MySQL schema to manage study room bookings and prevent double-booking conflicts. Piloted the system with 120 students over 2 weeks, validating system design and eliminating scheduling errors.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard that consumes a REST API to display real-time order status updates. Containerised with Docker Compose for local development and testing.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Python or JavaScript to match the JD's primary language requirements; consider contributing to open-source projects using these languages.
Build or contribute to a distributed systems project (e.g., message queue, load balancer, or microservices orchestration) to directly demonstrate Distributed Systems expertise.
Pursue GCP certification (Associate Cloud Engineer) or deploy a project on Google Cloud Platform to align with the Google Cloud focus of the role.
final_resume.growth_note: Strong foundational match on Java, REST APIs, and system design thinking, but missing hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript, C++, and GCP—all explicitly listed in JD minimum qualifications. Fresher status (graduation 2025) is acceptable for SDE II at Google, but recommend gaining 6-12 months of professional experience or contributing to distributed systems projects before applying.
